{{Current events|year=2003|month=01|day=18|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
* A mass mobilization pulls together global [[Protests against the 2003 Iraq war|protests against the Iraq war]] in cities around the world, including Tokyo, Moscow, Paris, London, [[Montreal]], [[Ottawa]], [[Toronto]], [[Cologne]], [[Bonn]], [[Gothenburg]], [[Istanbul]] and [[Cairo]]. [[Not in Our Name|NION]] and [[Act Now to Stop War and End Racism|ANSWER]] hold protests in [[Washington, D.C.]] and [[San Francisco, California]].
* The [[Switzerland|Swiss]] yacht ''Allinghi'', captained by New Zealand skipper Russell Coutts, defeated ''Oracle'', a [[San Francisco, California]]-based yacht, to win the challenger final of the [[America's Cup]].  ''Allinghi'' will now face the New Zealand defender, yet to be determined.
* In Australia, the most devastating bushfire since the [[Ash Wednesday fires]] in 1983 hits [[Canberra]] and the [[Australian Capital Territory]].  Four people are to die, 520 homes and thousands of [[hectares]] of [[national park]] will be destroyed, 259 people will be admitted to [[The Canberra Hospital]] with burns and {{Nowrap|A$250 million}} will be paid by [[insurance]] companies.
* The [[Sengkang LRT line]] began operations, with 5 stations along the East Loop being opened at the same time operated by [[SBS Transit|SBS Transit Ltd]] using [[Mitsubishi Heavy Industries Crystal Mover C810]]s.
